views.createSql:
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT wearable_events_id, wearable_events_scheduled_time, wearable_tasks_vibration_events, wearable_tasks_notification_text 
           FROM wearable_events
           JOIN wearable_tasks
           ON wearable_events_task_description = wearable_tasks_id
           ORDER BY wearable_events_scheduled_time DESC
           LIMIT 1;
